specificFindings: All ordinary dagger pairs use restrained edge highlights and compact guards.

All eight bows retain distinct limb curvature, fittings and grip palettes at the shared scale.
limitations: Equipped-local views omit native hands and bodies.
Native materials, avatar fit, attack motion and bow draw/string response are not tested here.
Fragment and display reconstruction are offline transform checks, not native break or loot observations.
Small palette and fitting details need actual inventory and combat-camera review.
